description: Defines the Scalar class representing a 0-dimensional tensor with a single element, including constructors, type conversions, and symbolic representations.

classes.name: Scalar
classes.description: Represents a scalar value that can be a numeric, complex, or symbolic type, with various constructors and type conversion methods.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Decrements reference count and clears symbolic pointer if necessary.

methods.name: toSymInt
methods.description: Converts Scalar to SymInt if symbolic, otherwise to long.

methods.name: toSymFloat
methods.description: Converts Scalar to SymFloat if symbolic, otherwise to double.

methods.name: toSymBool
methods.description: Converts Scalar to SymBool if symbolic, otherwise to bool.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the ScalarType corresponding to the Scalar's value.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Returns the negation of the Scalar.

methods.name: conj
methods.description: Returns the complex conjugate of the Scalar.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the Scalar.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks equality with various types (numeric, complex, bool).
